text_description: Full runway look centered on a short black sleeveless mini dress or slip with a rounded scoop neckline, worn under an open ivory rope-net overlay. The overlay has a hand-knotted macramé/fishnet effect in large diamond openings, following a tank silhouette at the shoulders and neckline, then continuing past the black underlayer into a loose, uneven fringe hem around the upper thighs. The edges of the neckline, armholes, and sides appear softly frayed or trimmed with pale fibers, adding a raw coastal texture against the black base. At the waist, a narrow decorative belt or chain-like band with gold-toned shell/sea-life-style charms cinches the net layer and breaks up the straight mini silhouette. Additional dangling strands and gold-toned charms hang from the lower net fringe, especially at the front and sides, creating movement over the legs. The styling is accessorized with a chunky statement necklace made of pale shell- or stone-like pieces with gold accents, small warm-toned earrings, a large soft tote bag carried in one hand with black handles, beige body, horizontal green and pink stripes, and a colorful patterned panel near the top. Footwear is only partially visible, appearing as delicate gold-toned lace-up or strappy sandals. Overall the look reads as a beach-inspired luxury net dress ensemble, mixing a close black mini base with an airy handmade ivory overlay, dangling charms, and resort-style accessories.
